entities.summary: Style Of Eye (b. 1979-08-29, Vallentuna) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Vallentuna and Sweden. Known in the fields of sweden, composers & musicians, europe.
